blocks.title: Standard enthalpy change of neutralization
blocks.text: Standard enthalpy change of neutralization, delta Hn, woh enthalpy tabdeeli hai jab standard halaat ke tehat acid aur alkali ke reaction se pani ka ek mole bane. Yeh hamesha exothermic hai.

HCl se NaOH ki neutralization ki enthalpy -57.1 kJ fi mol hai. Jab solutions milaye jate hain to wahid tabdeeli pani ke molecules ka banna hai, Na+ aur Cl- solution mein azad ions ke taur par reh jate hain; to neutralization ki enthalpy mehz apne ions se liquid pani ke ek mole ki heat of formation hai, H+(aq) + OH-(aq) se H2O(l), delta Hn = -57.1 kJ fi mol. Sab strong acid-strong base reactions ke liye delta Hn hamesha -57.1 kJ fi mol ke qareeb hai.

blocks.prompt: KOH se HNO3 ki neutralization ki enthalpy NaOH se HCl ki taqreeban barabar kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono strong acids aur strong alkalis hain, solution mein poori tarah ionized. K+ aur NO3- ions, Na+ aur Cl- ki tarah, solution mein be-tabdeel rehte hain; har soorat mein wahid reaction H+(aq) + OH-(aq) se H2O(l) hai, to dono pani ke fi mole taqreeban 57.1 kJ kharij karte hain.

items: Delta Hn: acid aur alkali se pani ka ek mole, hamesha exothermic; strong acid aur strong alkali -57.1 kJ fi mol ke qareeb kyunke wahid tabdeeli H+ + OH- se H2O hai.
